# Your Daily Briefing – 20 January 2026

Yesterday was a solid effort — 12.9km in 75 minutes with an average HR of 160bpm shows you were working genuinely hard, and combined with 20,586 steps your total burn hit 3,832 kcal. That's a big day on your legs.

Recovery is telling an honest story though. Your HRV sits at 93ms, below your 99–118ms baseline, and sleep at 6.3 hours is lighter than ideal. Your body absorbed a real load yesterday and hasn't fully processed it yet. I'd nudge today's session toward easy or moderate — protect the adaptation rather than fight through fatigue.

The calorie gap yesterday was significant (3,832 burned vs 2,300 target), so prioritise hitting that 175g protein today and don't go too aggressive with the deficit — under-fuelling after hard efforts slows recovery and eats into muscle. Aim for 7–8 hours tonight too.
